question: Should this maintainer-labeled release-validation fixture PR proceed after a maintainer verifies the current-main contracts and accepts artifact-backed evidence for the focused test runs?
rationale: The protected label requires explicit maintainer handling, and the review environment could not complete the required source, scoped-policy, and history checks.

options.title: Verify and land the focused fixture refresh

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Ask for any expectation that no longer reflects the current contract to be corrected with focused evidence before merging.
